messages:
rachel_sales: Quick sync 12: Client (Helios Dynamics) signed PO but procurement flagged VAT mismatch. They want Redwood EU on invoice but MSA is under Redwood US. Also asked to add an SLA clause (99.9% for POC) and a one-line DPA reference. Need rapid agreement 12. @nate_legal @ana_finance can we do addendum + e-sign?

nate_legal: We can do a one-page cross-entity addendum: name Redwood Inference EU Ltd as billing counterparty on the OF, reference the existing US MSA as the governing contract, and narrow indemnity/liability so POC risk is limited. SLA request: we usually avoid uptime SLAs for POCs but can offer an availability target and credit cap. I'll draft and post redline. Need Helios KYC and who will sign for their side.

ana_finance: Small correction: it's ana_finance. Finance needs exact legal name for billing and IBAN. If billing = EU, invoices must have VAT number and be in EUR. Also confirm requested SLA credit impacts revenue recognition. For quick close, treasury can accept EU billing with a provisional invoice if addendum is signed by Thu. What's the POC value?

mike_solutions: POC value is EUR 7,500 (three-week test). We can scope SLA to response time for support (SLA credits capped at 10% of POC fee). No production guarantees. Data processing: minimal logs only. DPA reference should be the standard Redwood DPA v2 with EU controller language.

rachel_sales: Helios PO: HD-2025, VAT ES44556677, wants invoice to "Redwood Inference EU Ltd" in EUR, net30. They prefer DocuSign. Timeline: start next Tuesday. They asked if a single signature page can bind OF + addendum + DPA.

nate_legal: DocuSign is fine. We'll prepare envelope with OF + 1-pg addendum + DPA signature block. Include clause: "Electronic signatures binding" and explicit entity lines. For SLA, propose: "Availability target: 99.9% for POC; monetary remedy limited to credit not exceeding 10% of POC fee." That should be acceptable.

ana_finance: Confirmed net30. Treasury needs executed docs by Fri 16:00 CET to include in this month's AR. Please pass IBAN: DE12 3456 7890 1234 5678 90 and confirm VAT regno. Also add PO number on invoice. Invoice-bot, provisional invoice?

esign-bot: esign-bot: Recommended envelope: OF + cross-entity addendum + DPA v2. Single envelope, Helios sign first, Redwood EU sign second. Template: /ops/templates/crossentity-po-addendum-v1.docx. Audit trail enabled.

mike_solutions: Ops confirm we won't process sensitive data. DPA stays standard with processor subprocessor list link. No infra changes needed.

rachel_sales: Collecting KYC and PO now. Will route the redlines to Helios and request signature via DocuSign. Will update when signed. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
